steps.content: The Aurum Secretum has long been removed from the room, leaving nothing but emptiness. Hypatia stands by the window, gazing at the winding queue of people far below.
At the front are several hooded figures and the girl known as Horo. Without farewells, they will escort the Furorians away from this place, never to return.

Boom! Black sand slams against the barrier in the sky above Furor once again. The rock beneath her feet trembles as cracks spread across the mountainside. Hypatia looks up, her keen eyes spotting fractures forming in the barrier above.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The barrier is reaching its limit...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Well, you got what you wanted.
Another voice suddenly rings out in the room. It's Synex. She leans against the doorway, her lips curled in contempt.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The lab's gone, the townspeople have fled, and even that DisCity kid didn't stick around for you. After all that trouble, is this really the outcome you wanted?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What about you? Are you going to stop me?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm, there's no rush for that. They won't get far anyway. But I'm curious about something else...
Synex taps the corner of her lips, her smile unmistakably malicious.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Having been the perfect daughter all your life, has our goody-goody little lady suddenly hit her rebellious phase and decided to play the hero championing "justice"? Huh, how unexpected!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Just don't expect gratitude in return, even though you went through all that trouble to help them escape. Before long, they'll be so dazzled by their new lives that they'll forget all about you. Remember, it was that purple-haired girl who actually led them out, not you.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: There's still time. Capture them and bring them back. You can still win back your family's trust.
Hypatia doesn't respond immediately. She continues gazing out the window, and only after several seconds does she begin softly.
[CG - Silhouette by the Window B]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...No. Perhaps it would be best if they forgot about me entirely.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Furor has never been a paradise. These people didn't come here willingly. They only arrived after losing their homes to endless disasters, with nowhere else to go. This isn't their fault, and they shouldn't die for it.

She gazes into the distance from the window. The evacuation procession winds through Furor's streets, gradually disappearing behind distant rocks. One by one, the lights that have long illuminated the caverns go dark, leaving only sand beasts and Corruptors to roam the streets.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Hella will help them find a new home. Perhaps somewhere far from Fraser. Maybe somewhere in DisCity, even. There will certainly be help waiting for them there. <color=#fb9259>He</color> will find a way.
steps.female_content: Hella will help them find a new home. Perhaps somewhere far from Fraser. Maybe somewhere in DisCity, even. There will certainly be help waiting for them there. <color=#fb9259>She</color> will find a way.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: All the other researchers have already left the lab. It's at least a day's journey to return to Fraser from here. Furor has lost its value now, so my family won't bother tracking down the refugees.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: They won't need to fear pursuers or worry about the Apostle anymore. Now, only the final step of the plan remains...
[Background - Hypatia's Room - Night]
Hypatia turns to face the intruder. Right now, Aurum Secretum is flowing through her arm, extending downward discreetly... reaching directly under Synex's feet.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Stay where you are. Don't go causing more trouble.
Whoosh! The Aurum Secretum instantly transforms into manacles, binding Synex and pinning her against the wall. After a stunned moment, the woman doesn't appear angry, but instead laughs.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hahaha, caught me off guard! Impressive! So this is your game, you had it all planned out...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Have you told your cute little accomplice that your so-called perfect plan is to distract the Apostle using yourself as bait?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Everyone has gone, leaving you all alone to be slowly buried together with Furor, suffocating quietly beneath the sand... By then, it'll be too late to regret your decision.
The chain tightens, cutting deep into Synex's skin and leaving several angry red marks.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Or what? Get choked constantly by a collar like you until the day I die instead?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is the best way out. The Apostle of Ashes will be drawn to the Sinner who controls the Aurum Secretum, while everyone else can make it out safely.
She looks down to see the last figures disappearing between the rocks. The shaking intensifies as the fractures in the barrier begin to deepen and expand. Time is running out.
The barrier suffers another impact. Behind the mountain, the Apostle is poised like a predator, each of its strikes shaking Furor violently like an earthquake.
She crouches down, her fingers gently brushing over the Aurum Secretum chain restraining Synex. It glows faintly as a crack forms.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But despite everything, I do not wish to endanger others as I take my own revenge.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: These restraints will deactivate before the barrier crumbles completely. Time is of the essence... but it should be enough for you to slip away.
The bound woman struggles, forcing her lips into a mocking smile.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: How touching! Such a shame my hands are tied up, or I'd give you a proper round of applause.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So... is this what you're after? To be a glorious, lonely hero that no one will remember?
Her question is left unanswered. The blonde girl rises to her feet and walks out of the room.
[City - Day]
The protective barrier suffers another attack, the cracks growing more visible.
The day is breaking as dawn pierces through the dark clouds above Furor, but the Apostle's miasma hangs too heavy. The first light stands alone, too feeble to illuminate the entire city.
Black sand rushes through cracks in the rocks into the city, dragging up the hem of a cape. She lifts her head, aiming the recording device in her hand forward.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: ...Code FU-2109, Furor research site, final experiment.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: Target: Apostle of Ashes N-05. Test Subject: Ash Crystal resonator—Hypatia Campbell.
She walks forward without hesitation as the camera faithfully records everything.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: City evacuated. Ash Crystal activated. Aurum Secretum resonance limit unlocked. Experiment entering final phase.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: Target Apostle exists in a fragmented state, making it difficult to capture. The plan is to use the spiritual energy of a high-ranking Sinner as bait to draw it into Furor for complete elimination.
Sand beasts and Corruptors assault ceaselessly, but she clears a path forward while maintaining a steady voice as she continues speaking.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: Additionally, to facilitate the decoy, Furor's outer Aurum Secretum barrier must be deactivated, allowing the Apostle to precisely lock onto the Sinner's location.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: The barrier will be completely destroyed in approximately fifteen minutes. Only one operator remains and repair requirements cannot be fulfilled. Once initiated, this plan cannot be interrupted. There is no turning back.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: I will record the entire battle process. This will serve as valuable sample data. I hope this record will benefit those who follow this same path of Aurum Secretum research in the future.

steps.speaker: Voice-over
steps.content: As for the Furorians...
She stops in her tracks and sets down the recording device.
Aurum Secretum flows slowly across her arm as the emerald crystal in her palm resonates with the surrounding metal. Mania levels begin to rise.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: They will survive. I will make sure of it. Someday they'll be able to leave Furor and their hatred behind, and embrace their new lives.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No matter what, no one should be trapped here. They deserve better lives...
The Aurum Secretum hums, poised for release. The girl prepares to step onto her battlefield.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is my duty. I will give everything for this, no matter the cost.
